description: This file provides a service layer for handling 'courses' related data, including fetching a list of courses with pagination and search, and updating individual course records via interactions with a Supabase database.

methods.name: actionableError(prefix, error)
methods.description: Constructs a detailed error message with helpful hints based on the error message received.

methods.name: getCourses({ limit = 50, offset = 0, search = '' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of courses from the database with optional pagination and search filters.

methods.name: updateCourse(id, updates)
methods.description: Updates a course identified by its ID with the provided data and returns the updated record.

ctags.name: getCourses
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getCourses({ limit = 50, offset = 0, search = '' } = {}) {$/
